kaue01.title: Table for one, and loving it
kaue01.caption:
The host said "just one?" like it was a problem. Aries heard "the whole booth is yours."
Dessert first, obviously. Who else orders like this?

kaue02.title: Slept diagonal, woke up thriving
kaue02.caption: Four pillows, zero blanket thieves, one Taurus sleeping corner to corner. Tell us your sign sleeps diagonal too.

kaue03.title: Went to the concert solo
kaue03.caption: Gemini turned to say "did you SEE that" and remembered they came alone. So they sang both parts of the duet instead. Have you ever gone to a show solo?

kaue04.title: Cooked for one, made enough for twelve
kaue04.caption: Cancer tried to cook for one person and accidentally fed every day of the next two weeks. Labelled, of course. Who in your life cooks like this?

kaue05.title: Bought myself the flowers
kaue05.caption: To: Leo. From: Leo. With love. The photo shoot that followed was not optional. When did you last buy yourself something nice?

kaue06.title: A Friday night with a 1,000-piece puzzle
kaue06.caption: 999 pieces down, one missing, full panic. Virgo found it in the last place anyone would look: under Virgo. What's your favourite quiet Friday?

kaue07.title: Picked the restaurant in under a minute
kaue07.caption: Libra picked dinner in under a minute. Nobody to ask, nobody to "you pick" with. Growth, or just hungry? Tag your indecisive friend.

kaue08.title: Didn't check their story. Not once.
kaue08.caption: 2 a.m., thumb hovering over their story. Scorpio put the phone face down and made tea instead. What's your 2 a.m. move?

kaue09.title: Booked the solo trip at 1 a.m.
kaue09.caption: Booked a solo trip at 1 a.m. Passengers: one. Seat: window. Which sign does this the most?

kaue10.title: Did nothing on Friday, on purpose
kaue10.caption: Capricorn put "nothing" in the calendar, then worried the nothing was behind schedule. Then fell asleep. When did you last do nothing on purpose?

kaue11.title: A kitchen dance party for one
kaue11.caption: Kitchen concert, wooden spoon mic, sock slide finale. The audience was zero people, one Pisces on video, and it was still a sellout.

kaue12.title: Pisces named the houseplant
kaue12.caption: One new leaf and Pisces is a parent now. Meet Mr. Leaf. He has a scarf. Who else talks to their plants?

kaue13.title: “So, are you seeing anyone?”
kaue13.caption: "So, are you seeing anyone?" Boss fight at the family dinner. Aries won with three words and a second helping of potatoes.

kaue14.title: Third wheel, main character
kaue14.caption: Third wheel? Leo took the couple's photo, then got pulled into the next one. Best seat on the bench. Who's your third-wheel legend?

kaue15.title: Slept through the 2 a.m. “u up?”
kaue15.caption: Three "u up?" texts at 2 a.m. Libra slept through every one, read them in the morning and moved on. Peaceful.

kaue16.title: Single Saturday: the full playthrough
kaue16.caption: A whole single Saturday, played like a game: snooze boss, brunch co-op, errands speedrun and the final boss, the wedding seating plan. Watch what happens at table nine.

kaue17.title: The holiday party, solo mode
kaue17.caption: Holiday party, solo mode. Three rounds of "still single?", a photo booth for two used by one, and an exit on their own terms. Which level is hardest for you?

kaue18.title: Week one after the breakup: the run
kaue18.caption: Week one after a breakup, played day by day: eat something, skip the sad songs, don't send the text, let friends in. Day 7 is the good part.

kaue19.title: New Year's Eve with no one at midnight
kaue19.caption: No one to kiss at midnight? Aquarius found everyone else who was solo and made a crew. Best countdown of the night.

kaue20.title: Every sign's single-life achievement
kaue20.caption: Twelve signs, twelve small wins of single life, one per sign, and Pisces saved for last. Which one is yours?
